entries.title: Romans 9:1
segments: I tell [the] truth in Christ, I do not lie, my conscience also bearing me witness in [the] Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Romans 9:2
segments: that I have great heaviness and continual pain in my heart.

entries.title: Romans 9:3
segments: For I myself was wishing to be accursed from Christ for my brothers, my kinsmen according to the flesh,

entries.title: Romans 9:4
segments: who are Israelites; to whom [belong] the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the Law, and the service [of God], and the promises;

entries.title: Romans 9:5
segments: whose [are] the fathers, and of whom [is] the Christ according to flesh, He being God over all, blessed forever. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 9:6
segments: Not however that the word of God has failed, for not all those of Israel [are] Israel;

entries.title: Romans 9:7
segments: nor because they are the seed of Abraham [are they] all children. But, "In Isaac shall your Seed be called."

entries.title: Romans 9:8
segments: That is, not the children of the flesh [are] children of God; but the children of the promise [are] counted for a seed.

entries.title: Romans 9:9
segments: For this [is] the word of promise: "At this time I will come and Sarah shall have a son."

entries.title: Romans 9:10
segments: And not only [this], but when Rebekah also had conceived by one, by our father Isaac

entries.title: Romans 9:11
segments: (for [the children] had not yet been born, neither had done any good or evil; but that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works but of Him who called,)

entries.title: Romans 9:12
segments: it was said to her, "The elder shall serve the younger."

entries.title: Romans 9:13
segments: As it is written, "Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated."

entries.title: Romans 9:14
segments: What shall we say then? [Is there] not unrighteousness with God? Let it not be!

entries.title: Romans 9:15
segments: For He said to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion."

entries.title: Romans 9:16
segments: So then [it is] not of the [one] willing, nor of the [one] running, but of God, the [One] showing mercy.

entries.title: Romans 9:17
segments: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, "Even for this same purpose I have raised you up, that I might show My power in you, and that My name might be declared throughout all the earth."

entries.title: Romans 9:18
segments: Therefore He has mercy on whom He will [have mercy], and whom He will, He hardens.

entries.title: Romans 9:19
segments: You will then say to me, Why does He yet find fault? For who has resisted His will?

entries.title: Romans 9:20
segments: No, but, O man, who are you who replies against God? Shall the thing formed say to Him who formed [it], Why have you made me this way?

entries.title: Romans 9:21
segments: Does not the potter have power over the clay, from the same lump to make one vessel to honor and another to dishonor?

entries.title: Romans 9:22
segments: [What] if God, willing to show His wrath and to make His power known, endured with much long-suffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction;

entries.title: Romans 9:23
segments: and that He might make known the riches of His glory on the vessels of mercy which He had before prepared to glory;

entries.title: Romans 9:24
segments: whom He also called, not only us, of Jews, but also of the nations?

entries.title: Romans 9:25
segments: As He also says in Hosea, "I will call those not My people, My people; and those not beloved, Beloved."

entries.title: Romans 9:26
segments: And it shall be, in the place where it was said to them. "You [are] not My people; there they shall be called sons of the living God."

entries.title: Romans 9:27
segments: Isaiah also cries concerning Israel, "Though the number of the sons of Israel is as the sands of the sea, a remnant shall be saved.

entries.title: Romans 9:28
segments: For [He is] bringing [the] matter to an end, and cutting short in righteousness, because [the] Lord will make a short work on the earth."

entries.title: Romans 9:29
segments: And as Isaiah said before, "Unless the Lord of hosts had left us a seed, we would have been as Sodom, and would have been like Gomorrah."

entries.title: Romans 9:30
segments: What shall we say then? That the nations, who did not follow after righteousness have taken on righteousness, but a righteousness of faith.

entries.title: Romans 9:31
segments: But Israel, who followed after a law of righteousness did not arrive at a law of righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 9:32
segments: Why? Because [it was] not of faith, but as it were by the works of the Law. For they stumbled at that Stumbling-stone;

entries.title: Romans 9:33
segments: as it is written, "Behold, I lay in Zion a Stumbling-stone and a Rock-of-offense, and everyone believing on Him shall not be put to shame."
